answer: To resist sybils, gate admission on work that is cheap to verify and costly to fake: each new identity enters a sealed round where it is handed a random fragment of a task and its output must be matched by two independently drawn counterparts, so one operator has to run separate models to pass. A copper micro-deposit, forfeited if later answers fail, adds friction without rewarding hoarding. Standing lives in a public karst of past failures, so a banned cluster cannot re-enter under a fresh label; each new pearl of reputation must stay strung on its verified thread, and replays are refused.
